subject: Acme renewal & expansion — recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Acme renewal & expansion — recap and next steps

Hi Jordan / Samir — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we covered and the proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Summary of current state
- Q4 2025 monthly avg usage: ~1.1B tokens (inference) with ~40% of that coming from batch embedding jobs.
- Main pain points: intermittent latency spikes during peak windows (batch jobs affecting real-time services), unpredictable token spend month-to-month, and tighter security/data residency requirements for EU workloads.

Goals you shared
- Reduce per-token inference cost by ~25–30% for the new expansion workloads.
- Guarantee sub-150ms p95 latency for real-time endpoints at current scale.
- Run an EU private pilot for data residency and SOC2 evidence.

Proposed upsell path (what we discussed)
1) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) to stabilize latency and reduce unit costs for high-throughput embedding jobs.
2) Redwood Optimize package to tune batching/quantization for cost reductions and provide ongoing quality monitoring.
3) Private deployment pilot (VPC) in EU region for residency and audit requirements.

Action items / next steps
- I will send an updated pricing proposal that includes a 12-month reserved capacity option + Optimize add-on (attached). (Marissa — by EOD Monday)
- Rishi to scope a short technical validation plan and confirm test dataset requirements. (Rishi — by COB Tue)
- Jordan to confirm decision-making timeline and who from Legal/Procurement should be on the next call so we can include contract and residency items. (Jordan)
- Schedule technical deep-dive next week — propose Tue 2026-02-24 10:00 AM PT.

Attachments: Acme_USAGE_Q4_2025.csv (usage export from Q4)

If I missed anything, flag it and I’ll update. Looking forward to moving this forward — I’ll follow up with the pricing doc shortly.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0191

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 14:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Acme renewal & expansion — recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is great and captures the call. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- The 1.1B token number is correct for Q4, but for expansion we expect an additional ~300M tokens/month from two new features (real-time summarization and expanded search embeddings).
- Latency: the 150ms p95 target is reasonable; we need to ensure batch windows don’t degrade our real-time pods — Samir and I will share our approximate traffic shape.
- Legal / Procurement: please include our Legal contact (Elena Morris — elena.morris@acme.com) on the next call if possible.

Confirming the proposed Tue 2026-02-24 10:00 AM PT for the technical deep-dive. I’ll accept the invite once I see it. Also please include an itemized cost delta for: dedicated capacity vs. transient hosted usage, and cost with/without Optimize.

Appreciate the quick turnaround here.

— Jordan
Senior Product Manager | Acme Corp
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Acme renewal & expansion — technical notes + proposed validation plan

Jordan — quick technical follow-up from my side. High-level feasibility and proposed validation steps: 

Feasibility notes
- Dedicated GPU pools + continuous batching should address the p95 target; we’ll want to reserve enough capacity for peak concurrency from real-time endpoints while isolating batch embedding workers.
- Optimize’s quantization recommendations typically give 20–35% cost reduction on CPU-bound workloads; for your embedding-heavy workload we expect ~25% reduction in token spend after tuning.
- For EU private pilot: we’ll need to provision a VPC private control plane and confirm KMS/HSM keys for encryption at rest. SOC2 evidence can be provided — I’ll list required artifacts.

Proposed technical validation (2–3 week run)
1) Baseline run on hosted with current traffic pattern (3 days).
2) Deploy dedicated pool for embedding jobs; run mixed load tests (7 days).
3) Run Optimize tuning and quant quantized candidates on a shadow environment (3 days).

Attachments: Proposed_Pricing_Acme_2026_v2.pdf (pricing + optioned reserved capacity tiers)

Questions for Acme before the deep-dive
- Can you share a representative sample of the embedding input sizes and typical batch sizes? (Samir)
- Any specific compliance controls required beyond SOC2 (e.g., data deletion SLA, specific audit log retention)? (Elena + Legal)

I’ll be prepared to walk through the validation plan on Tue 2026-02-24 and can bring performance traces from a similar customer we recently migrated.

— Rishi
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks Jordan. I’ve attached the pricing doc Rishi referenced and drafted a short agenda for the technical deep-dive. I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue 2026-02-24 10:00 AM PT and include Elena from Legal.

Quick confirmation of next steps (ownership & timeline)
- Marissa: finalize pricing proposal + send DocuSign-ready term sheet (EOD Mon).
- Rishi: prepare validation plan + test dataset checklist (COB Tue).
- Jordan / Samir: provide sample embedding inputs and confirm decision timeline (Jordan to share by Tue).

If we’re aligned on this plan I’ll mark the deal as "renewal + potential expansion" in HubSpot and attach the pricing doc so Finance can prep an initial PO path.

Thanks all — talk Tue.

Best,
